chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who believe and do righteous deeds.
Except for what they voluntarily surrendered of themselves.

key_terms.اسْتَحَلَّهُمْ: They made permissible for themselves / voluntarily surrendered

ai.seo_question: What is the source of Satan's power over believers according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifying that Satan’s dominion is not inherent but contingent upon human free will, specifically when believers voluntarily 'concede' themselves to him through sin. This distinction underscores the Shia theological principle of *Ikhtiyar* (choice), affirming that while Satan has authority over those who submit to him, he remains powerless over the *Ahl al-Bayt* and the steadfast believers who retain their spiritual agency.
